component.name: YouTube Comment Extractor Service
component.summary: Background extraction daemon and system tray controller for YouTube Comment Extractor

description.p: YouTube Comment Extractor Service provides a background REST API, WebSocket progress streamer, and system tray indicator (StatusNotifierItem) for the YouTube Comment Extractor ecosystem.
It allows client applications and web dashboards to run heavy extraction tasks asynchronously in the background with minimal host resource usage.

ul.li: System Tray Control: Start, stop, and inspect the extractor daemon directly from the top panel
REST & WebSocket API: Real-time progress updates and JSON payloads for external dashboards and scripts
Local Web Dashboard: Embedded browser interface accessible from any browser on localhost
Low-Footprint Daemon: Lightweight background runner with zero overhead when idle
